package.name: TO-92 (ECB; Toshiba 2-5F1B)
package.source: Toshiba 2SC2240 data sheet (2003-03-25, 6 pages), page 1: outline 2-5F1B (JEDEC TO-92), 1. emitter, 2. collector, 3. base

fit.figure: hFE – IC, VCE = 6 V, 25 °C (page 3, by pixel; to 105 mA, past which the three temperature lines bunch); VBE from the table's 0.65 V typ at VCE = 6 V, IC = 2 mA, and the h PARAMETER – IC figure's hie/hfe (page 4, VCE = 6 V, 25 °C) integrated from it; the linear IC – VBE figure disagrees with both by 50 mV and isn't used; VCE(sat) – IC, IC/IB = 10, 25 °C (page 3, by pixel; under 3 mA the three lines overlap and the band's middle is read); page 2, Cob 3.0 pF typ at VCB = 10 V, IE = 0, f = 1 MHz; page 2: fT 100 MHz typ at VCE = 6 V, IC = 1 mA
fit.method: Gummel-Poon (scripts/fit_models.py). IS, NF, BF, ISE, NE, IKF, NKF and RE by least squares on the hFE and VBE(on) curves at VCE = 6 V together (points: the curves read at 1-2-5 steps); no Early voltage (VAF left out): the IC – VCE figures (page 3) draw the lines flat within a pixel or two from 1 to 10 V; no output admittance in the table, so none is set (ngspice's default). BR, ISC, NC and RC by least squares on the VCE(sat) curve, the hFE points held, NR = NF, at IC/IB = 10. CJC from Cobo (one point: VJC, MJC ngspice's defaults); no Cibo on the sheet, so CJE is left out. ISC at most 1e-10 A: capped as the 2SC1815's (D-187): the sheet gives only ICBO under 0.1 µA at 120 V, so the fitter's bound isn't taken as the part's leakage. TF from fT 100 MHz at 1 mA (page 2: fT 100 MHz typ at VCE = 6 V, IC = 1 mA), less the junctions' charging time. Fitted curves are matched within 1.1 % (hFE), 0.4 mV (VBE) and 0.9 mV (VCE(sat)). RB, VAR, TR and the temperature terms are ngspice's defaults: the sheet doesn't pin them
fit.note: The sheet draws one typical gain line (about 300 to 320 from 1 to 30 mA at VCE 6 V), a GR-grade unit; a BL part (350-700) is common: measure yours (D-130). The h-parameter figure's small-signal hfe (220 to 254) sits under the DC line, as usual.

validation.note: Gain on the Geofex tester (D-130, D-153): 9 V, collector through 2.4 kΩ, 2.2 MΩ from base to supply; collector current less the leakage, over the base current. Where a measured transistor's form starts.
